dedupe_keys.name: air passenger origin and destination transborder portions of international journeys traffic volumes ranked by city pair exceeding 400 outbound plus inbound passengers annual

description: Five annual Statistics Canada CSV tables describe transborder air-passenger origin–destination movements, retaining different reporting thresholds and populations. City totals exceed 200 passengers; city-pair rankings exceed 4,000 for transborder journeys or 400 for transborder portions of international journeys. Detailed city and city-pair tables use an over-400 threshold. Native dates span 1997–2018, with one end field reading 1 January 2018. Two HTML publication members report Canada–United States origin–destination statistics for source-described windows within 2002–2016. These related tables and reports are curator-grouped without asserting numerical equivalence, equal thresholding or identical coverage. Values below publication thresholds and individual travel records are not established. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Stats Canada. Licence: Other (Open); License not specified. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says Open; isopen is true. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities.
